sources.entry: Charles - HTTP proxy/monitor to view HTTP and HTTPS traffic.

summary.name: Charles
summary.one_liner: Charles is an HTTP proxy and monitor that lets developers view and debug HTTP and HTTPS traffic between their machine and the Internet.
use_cases: Debugging HTTP and HTTPS requests and responses
Debugging Flash or Flex server interaction
Exploring iPhone App Store XML data
summary.what_it_does: Charles acts as an HTTP proxy, HTTP monitor and reverse proxy, letting a developer view all HTTP and SSL/HTTPS traffic between their machine and the Internet. It shows requests, responses and HTTP headers, including cookies and caching information. The page's changelog mentions features such as SSL/TLS debugging (4.2), HAR and SAZ file import (3.6), throttle settings, port forwarding, a SOCKS proxy (2.3), and a focus feature for hosts (3.9). The page also notes an iOS version released in 2018.
notable: Shows HTTP and HTTPS traffic including headers, cookies and caching info
Acts as HTTP proxy, monitor and reverse proxy
Charles 5.1 released 21 Apr 2026 per the page's news list
Changelog mentions Charles for iOS and HTTP/2 support
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page text is mostly a changelog and reviews list; current feature details and licensing are not shown
